name: rename-npm-scope-lattice-agent-to-lattice
title: Rename the npm scope @lattice-agent to @lattice (drop -agent); retire legacy @koala-agent global fallback; fix stale pre-push self-host check
description: The product is Lattice, not an 'agent'. Rename the live npm workspace scope @lattice-agent/{core,utils,lab} to @lattice/{core,utils,lab} across package names, cross-deps, internal imports, and self-host detection. Also fix the stale .githooks/pre-push self-host check (still keyed on the older @koala-agent/core, which silently disables its build+tsc gate for this repo) and retire the legacy @koala-agent/core global-install fallback. This is a self-host rename of the very package the Lattice CLI is built from, so consistency across package.json, npm workspace resolution, bin, and every self-host gate is load-bearing.
